headline: Approved three hiring requests, a revised Police Records Technician job description, and removal of one fire marshal candidate; tabled Library Branch Manager applications.
summary: The commission approved minutes from its prior regular meeting and three requests to fill positions. It also approved a revised Police Records Technician job description and removal of one candidate from the Deputy Fire Marshal eligibility list. Review of Library Branch Manager applications was tabled until the next meeting.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the prior regular meeting unanimously.
Approved requests to fill the Maintainer, Painter, and Deputy Fire Marshal positions unanimously.
Approved the revised Police Records Technician job description unanimously.
Approved removing N Borelli from the Deputy Fire Marshal Eligibility List (#26-14) unanimously.
Tabled review and approval of Library Branch Manager applications until the next meeting.
